RagShortTexts: Ghent formed a sprawling manufacturing commune whose armed textile militias checked.

Variants.Content: Positioned at the Scheldt-Leie confluence, Ghent was a dense textile metropolis governed by powerful weaver and fuller syndicates. Even from the imposing stone keep of Gravensteen, counts treaded warily around disciplined urban pike militias.
The municipal alarm bell Roeland summoned thousands of burghers armed with heavy pikes, transforming guild workshops into an impenetrable civic army.
